snippet.title: Airship Dragoon Trailer
snippet.description:
Turn-based, steampunk, squad tactics - available on STEAM. http://store.steampowered.com/app/308380/

Since I replaced my 10 years old Dell with a new "gaming PC" - I thought I should probably make a new trailer for Airship Dragoon, now that I have a computer that can actually play it fullscreen! ;)

Airship Dragoon is an old fashioned turn-based srategy game, avaialbe on Steam http://store.steampowered.com/app/308380
